```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB
import json

# Period data
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 35, "setup_cost": 468, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "2": {"demand": 50, "setup_cost": 382, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "3": {"demand": 43, "setup_cost": 405, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "4": {"demand": 28, "setup_cost": 373, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "5": {"demand": 48, "setup_cost": 304, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "6": {"demand": 20, "setup_cost": 450, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "7": {"demand": 35, "setup_cost": 230, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 1},
    "8": {"demand": 45, "setup_cost": 405, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "9": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 121, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "10": {"demand": 27, "setup_cost": 284, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "11": {"demand": 11, "setup_cost": 304, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "12": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 482, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "13": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 482, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "14": {"demand": 12, "setup_cost": 479, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 4},
    "15": {"demand": 21, "setup_cost": 259, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5}
}

# Capacity per period
capacity = {
    "1": 40, "2": 62, "3": 58, "4": 40, "5": 65, "6": 23, "7": 25, "8": 34,
    "9": 10, "10": 38, "11": 16, "12": 25, "13": 18, "14": 13, "15": 18
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("lot_sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Sets
periods = list(period_data.keys())

# Variables
production = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Objective
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[p]["setup_cost"] * setup[p] +
        period_data[p]["prod_cost"] * production[p] +
        period_data[p]["holding_cost"] * inventory[p]
        for p in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Constraints
for i, p in enumerate(periods):
    # Demand constraint
    if i == 0:
        model.addConstr(production[p] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[p] + inventory[periods[i-1]] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    
    # Capacity constraint
    model.addConstr(production[p] <= capacity[p] * setup[p])

    # Non-negativity of inventory
    model.addConstr(inventory[p] >= 0)

# Solve
model.optimize()

# Extract solution
solution = {
    "production": {p: int(production[p].X) for p in periods},
    "objective_value": model.ObjVal
}

# Output solution as JSON
print(json.dumps(solution))
```
